description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT against the tables staged on a Eurostat dataframe canvas, to reach observations past an inline preview and to aggregate or join them without re-fetching. Call eurostat_dataframe_describe first for the table and column names. Statement chaining, other verbs, and functions that read files or external data are rejected. Returns every complete row up to the canvas row limit.

canvas_id.description: The canvasId a eurostat_query_dataset, eurostat_download_dataset or eurostat_get_dimension_values response returned.

sql.description: One read-only SELECT over the names eurostat_dataframe_describe reports, e.g. SELECT geo, AVG(obs_value) AS mean FROM df_a1b2c3d4 WHERE time >= '2020' GROUP BY geo ORDER BY mean DESC.

name: eurostat_dataframe_query

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: This deployment runs without a dataframe canvas. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is unknown or expired. `missing_table`: The SQL names a table not staged on this canvas, or expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Row-limit cut disclosure with SQL paging guidance.

rows.description: Complete rows keyed by column name, nested cells as JSON. 64-bit integers arrive as strings; cast to DOUBLE in SQL for a number.

truncated.description: True when the canvas row limit cut rows: page the same deterministic SELECT over unchanged tables with a total ORDER BY (tie-breakers for tied keys) and LIMIT/OFFSET, advancing OFFSET by rowCount; an unordered first page restarts sorted at OFFSET 0.

title: Query Eurostat Dataframes
